methodology.limitations: Fresh illustrative transcripts authored and self-judged by the same model. No external API execution, independent judge, image input, or audio input. Pass judgments apply only to each sampled criterion, not reliability or every prompt branch.
methodology.teacherFeedbackReview: Static review confirms every exported prompt explicitly requires teacher feedback during chat: correction, modeling, retry, usage feedback, or feedback after a completed section. These samples illustrate those mechanisms rather than proving provider behavior.
methodology.revisionProvenance: 2 replacement and 0 additional same-model authored text-only role simulations, one self-judged sample per case. 7 unchanged-target case transcripts and judgments retained; integrity digests added. No external API or audio execution; samples illustrate scoped criteria, not reliability.
methodology.evidenceIntegrity: Canonical case SHA-256 covers instructions hash, inputs, responses, and judgments; it is an integrity check, not independent semantic validation. Added digests do not count as fresh model samples.
